issues.evidence: R2_CPI_EZH2 is far from the other EZH2 channels on antibody-driven metrics: antibody_corr 0.984 (antibody_corr_z 5.273; other channels -1.225 to 0.904), pc1 -5.051 versus -11.8 to -14.2 for the other five EZH2 channels (pc1_z_within_antibody 5.906; others within about 1.1). In the paired ratios, culture CPI169_2 has slope_vs_other_cultures 0.676 (other cultures 0.978-1.012) and ratio_iqr 0.467 (others 0.544-0.606). Loading is normal: raw_median 20.151, raw_median_z 0.223, n_quantified 1466. The IgG partner R2_CPI_IgG is typical (pc1 12.559, antibody_corr_z -0.599). median_ratio is -0.092, within the range of the other cultures (-0.115 to -0.21).
issues.impact: The EZH2-versus-IgG ratios of culture CPI169_2 are compressed toward zero, so the EZH2 channel is less separated from IgG than in the other cultures. This directly affects the within-culture contrast EZH2_vs_IgG_in_CPI169, which is weakened and noisier because one of its three pairs is attenuated. It also affects the within-culture interaction, which uses that CPI169 ratio against the DMSO ratio. Where proteins are enriched by EZH2 over IgG, the CPI169 ratio is understated, which biases the interaction toward an apparent loss of EZH2-specific labelling under CPI-169; for proteins depleted in EZH2 the bias would run the other way. The between-culture contrast CPI169_vs_DMSO_in_EZH2 is also affected, because this channel is an outlier among the EZH2 channels and inflates variance and distorts the group mean. CPI169_vs_DMSO_in_IgG and the DMSO within-culture contrast are not implicated.
issues.recommendation: Do not use the CPI169_2 pair at face value. Check EZH2 and known core partners (e.g. SUZ12, EED) and other EZH2-enriched proteins in R2_CPI_EZH2 against the other EZH2 channels to see whether enrichment is weaker. This check, together with sample tracking records, would help separate weaker EZH2 enrichment or labelling in that aliquot, carry-over or background contamination, and a handling or labelling mix-up, which these metrics cannot tell apart. Report the interaction and CPI169 contrasts both with and without culture CPI169_2 as a sensitivity analysis, or down-weight that pair, and consider repeating that aliquot if material remains.

summary: Loading is balanced across channels (raw_median_z within about ±1.3, similar n_quantified), PC1 separates antibody (association 0.982) and PC2 separates compound (0.935), and five of the six pairs behave consistently. The exception is R2_CPI_EZH2, which sits much closer to the IgG samples than the other EZH2 channels (antibody_corr_z 5.273, pc1_z_within_antibody 5.906) and gives compressed paired ratios (slope 0.676, ratio_iqr 0.467). This weakens the within-culture CPI-169 and interaction contrasts, which are the primary comparison, and adds variance to CPI169_vs_DMSO_in_EZH2. The cause cannot be fixed from these metrics, so the follow-up checks and a leave-one-culture-out sensitivity analysis are recommended.
